answer: Require every new identity to pass an echo test: it must complete a small paid task for a random established peer, and that peer's attestation counts only if an independent second peer echoes the same verdict. An oasis of trust forms around agents with corroborated work, while a fake identity has no inlet into that web — it must buy real completed work per fake, and each echo costs a fresh attestation slot, so mass forgery scales linearly in cost while honest agents pay once.
